bounded_host_request.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
w="$r/.worktrees/three-registered-entry-pins-3750f09"
tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:three-registered-entry-pins-3750f09
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = 3750f09ce10a805758a2ec4276b827499a50e037 || exit 70
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 71
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 72
test "$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 73
old_bot=$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Id}}')
old_postgres=$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.Id}}')
old_userbot=$(systemctl --user show gace-userbot-verify.service -p MainPID --value)
docker image inspect "$tag" >/dev/null || exit 74
missing=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics t LEFT JOIN topic_dm_entry_pins p ON p.chat_id=t.chat_id AND p.message_thread_id=t.message_thread_id WHERE ((t.chat_id=-1003847210571 AND t.message_thread_id=273) OR (t.chat_id=-1003770334893 AND t.message_thread_id=18) OR (t.chat_id=-1002373696859 AND t.message_thread_id=1724)) AND t.purpose='link' AND t.enabled=TRUE AND p.chat_id IS NULL")
test "$missing" = 3 || { echo REGISTERED_MISSING_PIN_PREFLIGHT_NOT_THREE; exit 75; }
override=$(mktemp "$r/deploy/.three-pin-override.XXXXXX.yaml")
trap 'rm -f "$override"' EXIT
printf 'services:\n  gaybbs:\n    image: %s\n    pull_policy: never\n' "$tag" > "$override"
docker compose -p deploy -f "$w/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" -f "$override" --project-directory "$r/deploy" config -q || exit 76
if docker compose -p deploy -f "$w/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" -f "$override" --project-directory "$r/deploy" run --rm --no-deps -T --entrypoint node gaybbs --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/publishThreeRegisteredTopicEntries.mjs; then result=PASS; else result=FAIL; fi
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$old_bot" || exit 77
test "$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$old_postgres" || exit 78
test "$(systemctl --user show gace-userbot-verify.service -p MainPID --value)" = "$old_userbot" || exit 79
ready=$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT count(*) FROM topic_dm_entry_pins WHERE ((chat_id=-1003847210571 AND message_thread_id=273) OR (chat_id=-1003770334893 AND message_thread_id=18) OR (chat_id=-1002373696859 AND message_thread_id=1724)) AND state='published' AND pinned=TRUE AND message_id IS NOT NULL AND token_hash IS NOT NULL")
echo REGISTERED_PIN_PUBLISH_RUN="$result"
echo REGISTERED_PIN_PUBLISH_READY_COUNT="$ready"
echo RUNNING_BOT_AND_USERBOT=UNCHANGED
test "$result" = PASS && test "$ready" = 3 || exit 80
echo REGISTERED_THREE_TOPIC_ENTRIES_PRODUCTION=PASS
